narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Five to the power four is five times four, which is twenty.
<bookmark mark='count'/>The exponent counts how many fives we multiply together.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Five times four only adds four fives, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 5 × 4 = 20; four fives appear in a row; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Count the equal factors. The factor is the base, and the count is the exponent.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Find six to the power three, and name its base and its exponent.
removed_beats.on_screen: the line base is the factor, exponent is the count appears; the words 6 to the power 3 appear with an empty box
